definitions.documentation: Reads the named global, adds amount, and writes the sum with SetGlobal. There is no nil-value fallback.
Returns immediately when stateGroup or stateName is nil. Otherwise forwards all three arguments to NativeAudioSetState and updates g_MusicState when the group is Music_State.

Ignores reentrant calls. Enters a cutscene with the speaker facing the listener, disables player movement and input, then invokes <name>_Func(name, speaker) if defined. Otherwise reads numbered _Text, _Mood, _Reaction and _Anim configuration values until text is empty. Restores movement and input on normal completion.
Enables sketches, paint/thinner abilities, and guardians, and calls SetHudFor2D(GetPlayer(), true).
Remembers g_MusicState, selects the requested Music_State on the player, and starts EndStinger in a thread. A nil duration defaults to 5; false is not treated as a missing value.
Disables sketches, paint/thinner abilities, and guardians, and calls SetHudFor2D(GetPlayer(), false).
Yields for duration, then restores the supplied previous Music_State on GetPlayer().
Passes tostring(levelPath) to TransitionToLevel. The first argument is unused.
Restricts cutscene input, fades out over 1, waits 1, plays the movie on GetPlayer(), fades in without HUD over 1, waits 1, and releases the input restriction.
Copies checkpointName and spawnName, replacing only nil with empty strings. Calls SaveGameToMemory(checkpointName, true, spawnName). The first argument is unused.
Calls SaveGameToMemory(checkpointName, false); nil checkpointName becomes an empty string. The first argument is unused.
Sets the player spawn transform to entity, then calls SaveGameToMemory(checkpointName, false); nil checkpointName becomes an empty string.
Passes tostring(interiorPath) to StreamInteriorZone. The first argument is unused.
Passes tostring(partPath) to StreamPart. The first argument is unused.
Yields for 0.1 between polls of GetDialogResponse. Returns nil for Aborted; otherwise returns the first response other than Waiting. The entity argument is unused.
